name: Click to Chat & WooCommerce Enquiry – Beepixl
author: beepixl

sections.description:
Click to Chat & WooCommerce Enquiry by Beepixl helps customers connect with you instantly using a chat button and enquiry system.

Easily add a floating chat widget, product enquiry buttons, and multi-agent support to increase conversions and customer engagement.

Perfect for store owners who want to provide fast support and capture more leads directly from product pages.

Features

  • Floating chat widget with multi-agent support
  • WooCommerce product enquiry button on product and shop pages
  • Click to chat functionality with pre-filled messages
  • Dynamic placeholders: {product_name}, {price}, {page_title}, {page_url}
  • Multiple agent profiles with avatar and response settings
  • Customize button colors, text, and position
  • Show on desktop, mobile, or both
  • GDPR consent support before opening chat
  • Shortcode [bpxl_whatsapp] with flexible layouts
  • Lightweight and fast loading

Why Use This Plugin?

  • Increase conversions with instant chat
  • Reduce cart abandonment with quick enquiries
  • Provide real-time support without complex setup
  • Works seamlessly with WooCommerce

WhatsApp Chat Features

  • Open chat with pre-filled product details
  • Automatically include product name and price
  • Multi-agent chat support for teams
  • Smart message customization
sections.installation:
1. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  2. Install and activate the plugin.
  3. Go to wp-admin → Enquiry settings.
  4. Configure chat button and agents.
  5. Enable floating widget and save.
sections.faq:
How do I embed a WhatsApp button in a page or post?

Default [bpxl_whatsapp] shows the strip card (green accent, avatar or WhatsApp circle, name, phone). Use id="919999999999" (digits only, matches the account phone) or agent="1" (0-based list order). phone="..." works like id. Add layout="icon" for icon-only; layout="meta" for name, title, and greeting block. agents="all" lists every account. In prefilled messages you can use {page_title}, {page_url}, {product_name}, {price}, {product_url}, {site_title}, {shop_url}, {site_url}. Optional class="my-class" on the wrapper.

How do I reset all settings and start fresh?

Deactivate the plugin, then Delete it from the Plugins screen. WordPress runs uninstall.php, which removes all plugin options and the bpxl_manage_whatsapp capability from roles. Upload and activate the plugin again to get a clean install (defaults only until you save new settings).
sections.changelog:
1.0.8

  • Fix WooCommerce product page and shop loop WhatsApp button: output the link HTML (action hooks do not use return values).
  • Default product button hook to woocommerce_single_product_summary when the saved position option is empty.

1.0.7

  • Rename plugin for better SEO and discoverability
  • Improved frontend widget UI
  • Performance improvements

1.0.6

  • Floating agent cards and shortcode use each account’s prefilled message (fallback to default message).
  • Improve message placeholders on shop, archives, terms, and single product ({page_title}, {page_url}, {product_name}, {price}, etc.).
  • GDPR: visible consent when shortcode and floating widget are both used; fix gated links with “open in new tab”.
  • Agent avatar: pick image from Media Library with circular preview; URL stored in a hidden field.
  • Misc. admin and script loading fixes.

1.0.5

  • Tighten readme header format for WordPress.org parser compatibility.

1.0.4

  • Fix WordPress.org readme short description format.

1.0.3

  • Rename plugin display name for clearer branding and compliance.
  • Use enquiry-for-website text domain across plugin files.
  • Remove remote Font Awesome dependency and use bundled WordPress Dashicons.
  • Add sanitization callbacks for all settings fields.
